Sub Makro1()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 7
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 210
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 30

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "BORDRO", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.line(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi *3,solmargin,0,sagmargin-solmargin)
	res = pe1.pensize(0)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin,solmargin+2,satiryuksekligi,50,"Rapor Tarihi / Saati")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop,solmargin+145,satiryuksekligi,20,"Sayfa No  1")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin + 2,satiryuksekligi,50,"Ýþyeri Adý")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop,solmargin+145,satiryuksekligi,20,"Dönem")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin + 2,satiryuksekligi,50,"Bölüm Adý")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin ,solmargin+34,satiryuksekligi,2,":")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin+34,satiryuksekligi,2,":")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin+34,satiryuksekligi,2,":")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 4,solmargin+35,satiryuksekligi,50,"KAZANÇLAR")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 4,solmargin+125,satiryuksekligi,50,"YASAL KESÝNTÝLER")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)

Sub Makro1()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 7
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 210
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 30

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "BORDRO", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 7
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 210
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 30

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "BORDRO", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 7
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 210
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 30

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "BORDRO", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 7
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 210
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 30

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "BORDRO", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.line(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi *3,solmargin,0,sagmargin-solmargin)
	res = pe1.pensize(0)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin,solmargin+2,satiryuksekligi,50,"Rapor Tarihi / Saati")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop,solmargin+145,satiryuksekligi,20,"Sayfa No  1")

Option Explicit
'#include <ImportExport.inc>
'/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
SirketKodu="AHMET"
ExportPrefix=""
ExportBatchMode="MT_LOAD_OR_NEW" 'BatchMode deðerler MT_NEW yada MT_LOAD_OR_NEW
ExportDosyaIsmi="C:\LLL.XML" 
WrkDir=SirketKodu
Sub Makro1()
	Dim ExportedVoucher
	Dim ImportedVoucher	

	Set par1=Doc.CreateSObject("Parameters")
	par1.SetParameter "BATCHOPT",ExportBatchMode

	ExportedVoucher=""
	ImportedVoucher=""

	if BirFirmadanBaskaBirFirmayaEvkrakKodGonderme(ExportedVoucher,ImportedVoucher) then
		Call EndProcess()
		MSGBOX "HATA"
		Exit Sub
	end if
	Call EndProcess()
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Dim i
	Dim t
	Dim ret
	Dim PERSM32E
	Set t=Doc.GetTableObject("LISTET")
	Set PERSM32E=Doc.GetTableObject("PERSM32E")
	for i=1 to t.GetRecCount()
		ret=Doc.Load_Voucher(t.EVRAKNO(i))
		if ret<>0 then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Kayýt Ekrana Getirilemiyor. Tekrar Deneyin","dinamo",MB_OK
			Exit Sub			
		end if
		PERSM32E.GERCEKLESENBSTAR=PERSM32E.RES_GERCEKLESEN_TARI
		ret=Doc.Save_Voucher()
		if ret<>0 then
			Doc.d7MsgBox "Kayýt Hatasý. Tekrar Deneyin","dinamo",MB_OK
			Exit Sub
		end if
	next
	ret=Doc.Load_Voucher(" ")

End Sub

Sub IseGirisBilgileriDoldur(ByVal ExcelSheet,ByVal Satir,ByVal PersonelNo)
	Dim Tbl_PERSMBT2
	Doc.RunCommand "CMD_CALISMA_UCRET_YENI_GIRIS_BASLA"
	Set Tbl_PERSMBT2=Doc.GetTableObject("PERSM0BT2")

	Dim AlanIsmi
	Dim AlanDegeri
	Dim Sutun
	For Sutun=2 To 100
		AlanIsmi=Trim(ExcelSheet.Cells(3, Sutun))
		AlanDegeri=ExcelSheet.Cells(Satir, Sutun)
		If AlanIsmi<>"" Then
			Tbl_PERSMBT2.SetFieldValue AlanIsmi,0,AlanDegeri
		End If
	Next

	Doc.RunCommand "CMD_CALISMA_UCRET_YENI_GIRIS_OK"
End Sub


Sub Makro1()
	Dim myExcel
	Dim mySheet
	Set myExcel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	myExcel.Workbooks.Open ("C:\CALISMA.XLS")
	Set mySheet = myExcel.Workbooks("CALISMA.XLS").Worksheets("CALISMA")

	Dim PersonelNo

	Dim I		
	For I=4 To 1000
		PersonelNo=Trim(mySheet.Cells(I, 1))
		If PersonelNo<>"" Then
			PersonelNo=Doc.LeftJustify(PersonelNo,16)
			Doc.Load_Voucher PersonelNo
			If Trim(Doc.GetLoadedVoucher())=Trim(PersonelNo) Then
				Call IseGirisBilgileriDoldur(mySheet,I,PersonelNo)
				Doc.Save_Voucher
			Else
				MsgBox(Trim(PersonelNo) & " Nolu Personel Bulunamadý")
			End If
		End If
	Next

	myExcel.Quit

	Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Dim myExcel
	Dim mySheet
	Set myExcel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	myExcel.Workbooks.Open ("C:\CALISMA.XLS")
	Set mySheet = myExcel.Workbooks("CALISMA.XLS").Worksheets("CALISMA")

	Dim PersonelNo

	Dim I		
	For I=4 To 1000
		PersonelNo=Trim(mySheet.Cells(I, 1))
		If PersonelNo<>"" Then
			PersonelNo=Doc.LeftJustify(PersonelNo,16)
			Doc.Load_Voucher PersonelNo
			If Trim(Doc.GetLoadedVoucher())=Trim(PersonelNo) Then
				Call IseGirisBilgileriDoldur(mySheet,I,PersonelNo)
				Doc.Save_Voucher
			Else
				MsgBox(Trim(PersonelNo) & " Nolu Personel Bulunamadý")
			End If
		End If
	Next

	myExcel.Quit

	Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub

            'ÜCRETSÝZ ÝZÝN

		exit Sub
	End if
	dim objExcel

			strPersNoExcel = objSheet1.Cells(satir,Sutun).Value
			i = satir
			if trim(strPersNoExcel) <> "" Then
				if Trim(strPersNoExcel)=Trim(strPersNo) Then
					'NORMAL ÇALIÞMA
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,4).Value) Then
						dblNormalCalisma=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,4).Value)
						MSGBOX dblNormalCalisma
					Else

					End if

 					'ÜCRETSÝZ ÝZÝN

					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,10).Value) Then 
						dbl100mesai=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,10).Value)
					Else
						dbl100mesai=cdbl(0)
					End if

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS01(c) = dblNormalCalisma
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_E_AS_E01(c) = dbl50mesai
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_E_AS_E02(c) = dbl100mesai

				End if
			End if
			if False Then 
				MSGBOX "Hata " & Err.Number & " " & Error()
				objWorkbooks(1).Close
				objExcel.Quit
				Exit Sub
				Set objExcel=Nothing
				Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
				Set objSheet1=Nothing
			End if	
		End if
		if False Then 
			objWorkbooks(1).Close
			objExcel.Quit
			Set objExcel=Nothing
			Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
			Set objSheet1=Nothing
			Exit Sub
		End if	
	Next
	
	objWorkbooks(1).Close

Açýklama : DOSTEL PUANTAJ-YENÝ
Kod : 
Glo_path="C:\NISAN.XLS"
Glo_satirsayisi = 300
Sub Makro1()
	on error resume next
	dim strFpath,intSatirSayisi
	Fpath = Glo_path
	strFpath = inputbox("Excel dosyasýnýn yolunu giriniz","Puantaj dosyasýnýn yolu",Glo_path)
	if trim(strFpath)="" Then 
		msgbox("Boþ dosya adý olamaz.Makroyu tekrar çalýþtýrýn.")
		exit Sub
	End if
	intSatirSayisi = inputbox("Excel dosyasýndan okunacak satýr sayýsý","Excel'deki satýr sayýsý",Glo_satirsayisi)
	if not isNumeric(intSatirSayisi) Then 
		msgbox("Boþ ya da yanlýþ satýr bildirimi.Makroyu tekrar çalýþtýrýn.")
		exit Sub
	End if
	dim objExcel
	Set objExcel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	dim objWorkbooks
	Set objWorkbooks = objExcel.Workbooks
	objWorkbooks.Open(strFpath)
	
	dim objSheet1
	Set objSheet1 = objWorkbooks(1).Worksheets(1)
	dim c,strPersNo
	dim dblNormalCalisma,dblHaftatatili,dblGenelTatil,dblYillikizin,dblucretliizin,dbldogum
	dim dblOlum,dblEvlenme,dblDoktor,dblSendika
	dim dblIstirahat,dblucretsiz,dbl100mesai,dbl50mesai

	if err.number<>0 Then 
		objWorkbooks(1).Close
		objExcel.Quit
		Set objExcel=Nothing
		Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
		Set objSheet1=Nothing
		Exit Sub
	End if	

	For c=1 to BRDR1PBGIRIS.GetRecCount
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Puantaj Bilgileri Aktarýlýyor : " & c & " / " & BRDR1PBGIRIS.GetRecCount
		'strPersNo = BRDR1PBGIRIS.C_KOD(c)
		SicilNo = BRDR1PBGIRIS.C_KOD(c)

		strPersNo = doc.getdbfieldvalue("PERSM0","EHLIYETNO",Sicilno,"")

		BRDR1PBGIRIS.SetCurrentRow(c)
		if not (xlsCell is Nothing) Then
			Sutun=1
			For ik=2 to Glo_satirsayisi
				if Trim(objSheet1.Cells(ik,sutun))=trim(strPersNo) Then
					satir = ik
					Exit For
				End if
			Next

			strPersNoExcel = objSheet1.Cells(satir,sutun).Value
			i = satir
	
			if trim(strPersNoExcel) <> "" Then
	
				if Trim(strPersNoExcel)=Trim(strPersNo) Then

					'NORMAL ÇALIÞMA
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,4).Value) Then
						dblNormalCalisma=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,4).Value)
					Else
						dblNormalCalisma=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'HAFTA TATÝLÝ
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,6).Value) Then
						dblHaftatatili=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,6).Value)
					Else
						dblhaftatatili=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'GENEL TATÝL
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,7).Value) Then
						dblGenelTatil=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,7).Value)
					Else
						dblGenelTatil=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'YILLIK IZIN
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,10).Value) Then
						dblYillikizin=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,10).Value)
					Else
						dblYillikizin=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'ÜCRETLÝ ÝZÝN 
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,11).Value) Then
						dblucretliizin=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,11).Value)
					Else
						dblucretliizin=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'DOÐUM ÝZNÝ
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,15).Value) Then
						dblDogum=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,15).Value)
					Else
						dblDogum=cdbl(0)
					End if
				'ÖLÜM ÝZNÝ
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,16).Value) Then
						dblOlum=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,16).Value)
					Else
						dblOlum=cdbl(0)
					End if
				'EVLENME ÝZNÝ
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,17).Value) Then
						dblEvlenme=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,17).Value)
					Else
						dblEvlenme=cdbl(0)
					End if
				'DOKTOR ÝZNÝ
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,20).Value) Then
						dblDoktor=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,20).Value)
					Else
						dblDoktor=cdbl(0)
					End if
				'SENDÝKA ÝZNÝ
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,21).Value) Then
						dblSendika=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,21).Value)
					Else
						dblSendika=cdbl(0)
					End if

 					'ÜCRETSÝZ ÝZÝN
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,12).Value) Then
						dblucretsiz=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,12).Value)
					Else
						dblucretsiz=cdbl(0)
					End if
 					'ÝSTÝRAHAT
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,14).Value) Then
						dblIstirahat=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,14).Value)
					Else
						dblIstirahat=cdbl(0)
					End if

					'%50 MESAI (SAAT)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,8).Value) Then
						dbl50mesai=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,8).Value)
					Else
						dbl50mesai=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'%100 MESAI(SAAT)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,9).Value) Then 
						dbl100mesai=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,9).Value)
					Else
						dbl100mesai=cdbl(0)
					End if

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS01(c) = dblNormalCalisma
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS02(c) = dblHaftatatili
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS03(c) = dblGenelTatil
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS04(c) = dblYillikizin
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS05(c) = dblucretliizin
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS06(c) = dbldogum
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS07(c) = dblOlum
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS08(c) = dblEvlenme
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS09(c) = dblDoktor
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS10(c) = dblSendika

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KIS01(c) = dblIstirahat
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KIS02(c) = dblucretsiz

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_E_AS_E01(c) = dbl50mesai
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_E_AS_E02(c) = dbl100mesai

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c) = Doc.div(dblNormalCalisma,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS02(c) = Doc.div(dblHaftatatili,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS03(c) = Doc.div(dblGenelTatil,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS04(c) = Doc.div(dblYillikizin,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS05(c) = Doc.div(dblucretliizin,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS06(c) = Doc.div(dbldogum,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS07(c) = Doc.div(dblOlum,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS08(c) = Doc.div(dblEvlenme,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS09(c) = Doc.div(dblDoktor,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS10(c) = Doc.div(dblSendika,7.5)

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KIS01(c) = Doc.div(dblIstirahat,7.5)
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KIS02(c) = 0


					SSKToplami = BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS02(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS03(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS04(c) _ 
					+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS05(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS06(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS07(c) _
					+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS08(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS09(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS10(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KIS01(c)_
						
					GirilmesiGirenSSK = BRDR1PBGIRIS.C_GEREKEN_SSKPRIMGUNU(c) 

					if SSKToplami > GirilmesiGirenSSK then
						Fark = SSKToplami - GirilmesiGirenSSK
						BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c) = BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c)-Fark
					End if
					if SSKToplami < GirilmesiGirenSSK then
						Fark1 = GirilmesiGirenSSK - SSKToplami
						BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c) = BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c)+Fark1
					End if
				

				End if
			End if
'			if err.number<>0 Then 
			if False Then 
				MSGBOX "Hata " & Err.Number & " " & Error()
				objWorkbooks(1).Close
				objExcel.Quit
				Exit Sub
				Set objExcel=Nothing
				Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
				Set objSheet1=Nothing
			End if	
		End if
		if False Then 
			objWorkbooks(1).Close
			objExcel.Quit
			Set objExcel=Nothing
			Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
			Set objSheet1=Nothing
			Exit Sub
		End if	
	Next
	
	objWorkbooks(1).Close
	objExcel.Quit

	Set objExcel=Nothing
	Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
	Set objSheet1=Nothing
	msgbox "Dosya aktarma iþlemi bitti."
End Sub

	Set objExcel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	dim objWorkbooks
	Set objWorkbooks = objExcel.Workbooks
	objWorkbooks.Open(strFpath)
	
	dim objSheet1
	Set objSheet1 = objWorkbooks(1).Worksheets(1)
	dim c,strPersNo
	dim dblNormalCalisma,dblHaftatatili,dblGenelTatil,dblYillikizin,dblucretliizin
	dim dblIstirahat,dblucretsiz,dbl100mesai,dbl50mesai,dbldevamsiz,dbleksik,dblmazaret1,dblmazaret2

	if err.number<>0 Then 
		objWorkbooks(1).Close
		objExcel.Quit
		Set objExcel=Nothing
		Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
		Set objSheet1=Nothing
		Exit Sub
	End if	

	For c=1 to BRDR1PBGIRIS.GetRecCount
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Puantaj Bilgileri Aktarýlýyor : " & c & " / " & BRDR1PBGIRIS.GetRecCount

		SicilNo = BRDR1PBGIRIS.C_KOD(c)
		PdksNo = doc.getdbfieldvalue("PERSM0","PDKSNO",SicilNo,"")
		strPersNo = trim(PdksNo)
		BRDR1PBGIRIS.SetCurrentRow(c)
		if not (xlsCell is Nothing) Then
			Sutun=1
			For ik=2 to Glo_satirsayisi
				if Trim(objSheet1.Cells(ik,sutun))=trim(strPersNo) Then
					satir = ik
					Exit For
				End if
			Next

			strPersNoExcel = objSheet1.Cells(satir,sutun).Value
			i = satir
	
			if trim(strPersNoExcel) <> "" Then
	
				if Trim(strPersNoExcel)=Trim(strPersNo) Then

					'NORMAL ÇALIÞMA
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,3).Value) Then
						dblNormalCalisma=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,3).Value)
					Else
						dblNormalCalisma=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'HAFTA TATÝLÝ
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,4).Value) Then
						dblHaftatatili=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,4).Value)
					Else
						dblhaftatatili=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'GENEL TATÝL
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,5).Value) Then
						dblGenelTatil=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,5).Value)
					Else
						dblGenelTatil=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'YILLIK IZIN
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,10).Value) Then
						dblYillikizin=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,10).Value)
					Else
						dblYillikizin=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'ÜCRETLÝ ÝZÝN 
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,8).Value) Then
						dblucretliizin=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,8).Value)
					Else
						dblucretliizin=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'DEVAMSIZ
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,6).Value) Then
						dbldevamsiz=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,6).Value)
					Else
						dbldevamsiz=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'EKSÝK
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,7).Value) Then
						dbleksik = cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,7).Value)
					Else
						dbleksik = cdbl(0)
					End if
					'ÜCRETSÝZ ÝZÝN
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,9).Value) Then
						dblucretsiz = cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,9).Value)
					Else
						dblucretsiz = cdbl(0)
					End if
					'MAZARET1
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,13).Value) Then
						dblmazaret1 = cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,13).Value)
					Else
						dblmazaret1 = cdbl(0)
					End if
					'MAZARET2
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,14).Value) Then
						dblmazaret2 = cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,14).Value)
					Else
						dblmazaret2 = cdbl(0)
					End if
					'%50 MESAI (SAAT)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,11).Value) Then
						dbl50mesai=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,11).Value)
					Else
						dbl50mesai=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'%100 MESAI(SAAT)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,12).Value) Then 
						dbl100mesai=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,12).Value)
					Else
						dbl100mesai=cdbl(0)
					End if

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS01(c) = dblNormalCalisma
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS02(c) = dblHaftatatili
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS03(c) = dblGenelTatil
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS04(c) = dblYillikizin
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS05(c) = dblucretliizin

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KIS01(c) = dblIstirahat
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KIS02(c) = dblucretsiz+dbldevamsiz+dbleksik+dblmazaret1+dblmazaret2

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_E_AS_E01(c) = dbl50mesai
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_E_AS_E02(c) = dbl100mesai


					SSKToplami = BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS02(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS03(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS04(c) _ 
					+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS05(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KIS01(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KIS02(c)
						
					GirilmesiGirenSSK = BRDR1PBGIRIS.C_GEREKEN_SSKPRIMGUNU(c) 

					if SSKToplami > GirilmesiGirenSSK then
						Fark = SSKToplami - GirilmesiGirenSSK
						BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c) = BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c)-Fark
					End if
					if SSKToplami < GirilmesiGirenSSK then
						Fark1 = GirilmesiGirenSSK - SSKToplami
						BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c) = BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c)+Fark1
					End if
				
				End if
			End if
			if False Then 
				MSGBOX "Hata " & Err.Number & " " & Error()
				objWorkbooks(1).Close
				objExcel.Quit
				Exit Sub
				Set objExcel=Nothing
				Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
				Set objSheet1=Nothing
			End if	
		End if
		if False Then 
			objWorkbooks(1).Close
			objExcel.Quit
			Set objExcel=Nothing
			Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
			Set objSheet1=Nothing
			Exit Sub
		End if	
	Next
	
	objWorkbooks(1).Close
	objExcel.Quit

	Set objExcel=Nothing
	Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
	Set objSheet1=Nothing
	msgbox "Dosya aktarma iþlemi bitti."
End Sub

			Exit Sub
		End if	
	Next

Makro Kaynak Kodu

Kod : 
Glo_path="C:\Puantaj.xls"
Glo_satirsayisi = 300
Sub Makro1()
	on error resume next

	dim strFpath,intSatirSayisi

	Fpath = Glo_path
	strFpath = inputbox("Excel dosyasýnýn yolunu giriniz","Puantaj dosyasýnýn yolu",Glo_path)

	if trim(strFpath)="" Then 
		msgbox("Boþ dosya adý olamaz.Makroyu tekrar çalýþtýrýn.")
		exit Sub
	End if

	intSatirSayisi = inputbox("Excel dosyasýndan okunacak satýr sayýsý","Excel'deki satýr sayýsý",Glo_satirsayisi)

	if not isNumeric(intSatirSayisi) Then 
		msgbox("Boþ ya da yanlýþ satýr bildirimi.Makroyu tekrar çalýþtýrýn.")
		exit Sub
	End if

	dim objExcel
	Set objExcel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	dim objWorkbooks
	Set objWorkbooks = objExcel.Workbooks
	objWorkbooks.Open(strFpath)
	
	dim objSheet1
	Set objSheet1 = objWorkbooks(1).Worksheets(1)
	dim c,strPersNo
	dim dblNormalCalisma,dblHaftatatili,dblGenelTatil,dblYillikizin,dblucretliizin
	dim dblIstirahat,dblucretsiz,dbl100mesai,dbl50mesai,dbldevamsiz,dbleksik,dblmazaret1,dblmazaret2
	dim dblIstirahat2, dblIstirahat1
	if err.number<>0 Then 
		objWorkbooks(1).Close
		objExcel.Quit
		Set objExcel=Nothing
		Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
		Set objSheet1=Nothing
		Exit Sub
	End if	

	For c=1 to BRDR1PBGIRIS.GetRecCount
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Puantaj Bilgileri Aktarýlýyor : " & c & " / " & BRDR1PBGIRIS.GetRecCount

		SicilNo = BRDR1PBGIRIS.C_KOD(c)
		PdksNo = doc.getdbfieldvalue("PERSM0","PDKSNO",SicilNo,"")
		strPersNo = trim(PdksNo)
		BRDR1PBGIRIS.SetCurrentRow(c)
		if not (xlsCell is Nothing) Then
			Sutun=1
			For ik=2 to Glo_satirsayisi
				if Trim(objSheet1.Cells(ik,sutun))=trim(strPersNo) Then
					satir = ik
					Exit For
				End if
			Next

			strPersNoExcel = objSheet1.Cells(satir,sutun).Value
			i = satir
	
			if trim(strPersNoExcel) <> "" Then
	
				if Trim(strPersNoExcel)=Trim(strPersNo) Then

					'NORMAL ÇALIÞMA (saat)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,2).Value) Then
						dblNormalCalisma=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,2).Value)
					Else
						dblNormalCalisma=cdbl(0)
					End if

					'HAFTA TATÝLÝ (SAAT)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,10).Value) Then
						dblHaftatatili=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,10).Value)
					Else
						dblhaftatatili=cdbl(0)
					End if

					'GENEL TATÝL (SAAT)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,12).Value) Then
						dblGenelTatil=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,12).Value)
					Else
						dblGenelTatil=cdbl(0)
					End if

					'YILLIK IZIN (saat)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,14).Value) Then
						dblYillikizin=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,14).Value)
					Else
						dblYillikizin=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'ÜCRETLÝ ÝZÝN (saat)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,16).Value) Then
						dblucretliizin=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,16).Value)
					Else
						dblucretliizin=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'DEVAMSIZ
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,4).Value) Then
						dbldevamsiz=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,4).Value)
					Else
						dbldevamsiz=cdbl(0)
					End if
				'	'EKSÝK
				'	if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,7).Value) Then
				'		dbleksik = cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,7).Value)
				'	Else
				'		dbleksik = cdbl(0)
				'	End if
					'ÜCRETSÝZ ÝZÝN
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,18).Value) Then
						dblucretsiz = cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,18).Value)
					Else
						dblucretsiz = cdbl(0)
					End if
					'ISTIRAHAT1
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,20).Value) Then
						dblIstirahat1 = cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,20).Value)
					Else
						dblIstirahat1 = cdbl(0)
					End if
					'ISTIRAHAT2
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,22).Value) Then
						dblIstirahat2 = cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,22).Value)
					Else
						dblIstirahat2 = cdbl(0)
					End if

				'	'MAZARET2
				'	if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,14).Value) Then
				'		dblmazaret2 = cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,14).Value)
				'	Else
				'		dblmazaret2 = cdbl(0)
				'	End if
					'%50 MESAI (SAAT)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,6).Value) Then
						dbl50mesai=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,6).Value)
					Else
						dbl50mesai=cdbl(0)
					End if
					'%100 MESAI(SAAT)
					if isnumeric(objSheet1.Cells(i,8).Value) Then 
						dbl100mesai=cdbl(objSheet1.Cells(i,8).Value)
					Else
						dbl100mesai=cdbl(0)
					End if

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS01(c) = dblNormalCalisma
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS02(c) = dblHaftatatili
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS03(c) = dblGenelTatil
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS04(c) = dblYillikizin
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KCS05(c) = dblucretliizin

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KIS01(c) = dblIstirahat1+dblIstirahat1
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AS_KIS02(c) = dblucretsiz+dbldevamsiz

					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_E_AS_E01(c) = dbl50mesai
					BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_E_AS_E02(c) = dbl100mesai


					SSKToplami = BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS02(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS03(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS04(c) _ 
					+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS05(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KIS01(c)+BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KIS02(c)
						
					GirilmesiGirenSSK = BRDR1PBGIRIS.C_GEREKEN_SSKPRIMGUNU(c) 

					if SSKToplami > GirilmesiGirenSSK then
						Fark = SSKToplami - GirilmesiGirenSSK
						BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c) = BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c)-Fark
					End if
					if SSKToplami < GirilmesiGirenSSK then
						Fark1 = GirilmesiGirenSSK - SSKToplami
						BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c) = BRDR1PBGIRIS.B_K_AP_KCS01(c)+Fark1
					End if
				
				End if
			End if

			if False Then 
				MSGBOX "Hata " & Err.Number & " " & Error()
				objWorkbooks(1).Close
				objExcel.Quit
				Exit Sub
				Set objExcel=Nothing
				Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
				Set objSheet1=Nothing
			End if	
		End if
		if False Then 
			objWorkbooks(1).Close
			objExcel.Quit
			Set objExcel=Nothing
			Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
			Set objSheet1=Nothing
			Exit Sub
		End if	
	Next
	
	objWorkbooks(1).Close
	objExcel.Quit

	Set objExcel=Nothing
	Set objWorkbooks=Nothing
	Set objSheet1=Nothing
	msgbox "Dosya aktarma iþlemi bitti."
End Sub

Sub Makro1()

	Tarih = doc.Today()
	Gun = Right(Tarih,2)
	Ay = Mid(Tarih,6,2)
	Yil = Left(Tarih,4) 
	OdemeTuru = "M" 'M: Maaþ, A:Avans

	dim fso
	set fso = CreateObject("SCRIPTING.FILESYSTEMOBJECT")
	Set f = fso.opentextfile("c:\SBEN_" & OdemeTuru & "_ "&Gun&Ay&yil&".txt",2,true,-2)
	
	satirSayisi = BRDR1TP.GetRecCount()

	Sablon = Inputbox("Personel Türünü Giriniz","SA-BA Dinamo")
	Sablon = trim(Sablon)
	
	FirmaKodu = "SBEN"
	Tarih = doc.Today()
	OdemeGunu = Right(Tarih,2)
	OdemeAyi = Mid(Tarih,6,2)
	OdemeYili = Left(Tarih,4) 	
	DovizKodu = "TRL"

	HeaderStr = Doc.LeftJustify(FirmaKodu, 10) & OdemeGunu & OdemeAyi & OdemeYili & OdemeTuru & Doc.LeftJustify(DovizKodu, 3)
	f.writeline HeaderStr
	Set fff = Doc.CreateSObject("BATCHERRORMODE")

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			
	if Sablon = trim(BRDR1TP.HESAPSABLONU(i)) then
		Kod = BRDR1TP.KOD(i)
		HesapNo = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM0","HESAPNO",Kod,"") 
		if trim(HesapNo) = "" Then Doc.d7MsgBox Kod & " kodlu personelin Banka Hesap No. su girilmemiþ", "", MB_OK
		Ad = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM0","AD",Kod,"")
		SoyAd = doc.GetDbFieldValue("PERSM0","SOYAD",Kod,"")

		HesapNo = Left(HesapNo,8)
 		Ad = Left(Ad,12)
 		SoyAd = Left(SoyAd,13)
		PersonelSicilNo = Space(9)
		Odenecek = BRDR1TP.NETODENECEK(i)
		StrOdenecek = Replace(Doc.NumFormat(Odenecek, 18,2), ",", "")
		StrOdenecek = Right(String(15, "0") & StrOdenecek, 15)

		OdemeStr = HesapNo & Ad & SoyAd & PersonelSicilNo & StrOdenecek
		
		f.WriteLine OdemeStr
	End if
	Next
	f.close()

	Set fso = nothing
	set f = nothing
End Sub

Sub IseGirisBilgileriDoldur(ByVal ExcelSheet,ByVal Satir,ByVal PersonelNo)
	Dim Tbl_PERSMBT2
	Doc.RunCommand "CMD_SATIR_DEGISIKLIK_BASLA" 

	'Doc.RunCommand "CMD_SATIR_DEGISIKLIK_FORMU"

	Set Tbl_PERSMBT2=Doc.GetTableObject("PERSM0BT2")

	Dim AlanIsmi
	Dim AlanDegeri
	Dim Sutun
	For Sutun=2 To 100
		AlanIsmi=Trim(ExcelSheet.Cells(3, Sutun))
		AlanDegeri=ExcelSheet.Cells(Satir, Sutun)
		If AlanIsmi<>"" Then
			Tbl_PERSMBT2.SetFieldValue AlanIsmi,0,AlanDegeri
		End If
	Next

	'Doc.RunCommand "CMD_SATIR_DEGISIKLIK_OK"
End Sub
Sub Makro1()
	Dim myExcel
	Dim mySheet
	Set myExcel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	myExcel.Workbooks.Open ("C:\CALISMA.XLS")
	Set mySheet = myExcel.Workbooks("CALISMA.XLS").Worksheets("CALISMA")

	Dim PersonelNo

	Dim I		
	For I=4 To 1000
		PersonelNo=Trim(mySheet.Cells(I, 1))
		If PersonelNo<>"" Then
			PersonelNo=Doc.LeftJustify(PersonelNo,16)
			Doc.Load_Voucher PersonelNo
			If Trim(Doc.GetLoadedVoucher())=Trim(PersonelNo) Then
				Call IseGirisBilgileriDoldur(mySheet,I,PersonelNo)
				Doc.Save_Voucher
			Else
				MsgBox(Trim(PersonelNo) & " Nolu Personel Bulunamadý")
			End If
		End If
	Next

	myExcel.Quit

	Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 7
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 210
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 30

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "BORDRO", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	'Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.line(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi *3,solmargin,0,sagmargin-solmargin)
	res = pe1.pensize(0)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 2,solmargin+2,satiryuksekligi,50,"Rapor Tarihi / Saati")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop,solmargin+145,satiryuksekligi,20,"Sayfa No  1")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin + 2,satiryuksekligi,50,"Ýþyeri Adý")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop,solmargin+145,satiryuksekligi,20,"Dönem")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin + 2,satiryuksekligi,50,"Bölüm Adý")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 2,solmargin+34,satiryuksekligi,2,":")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin+34,satiryuksekligi,2,":")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin+34,satiryuksekligi,2,":")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 5,solmargin+35,satiryuksekligi,50,"KAZANÇLAR")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 5,solmargin+125,satiryuksekligi,50,"YASAL KESÝNTÝLER")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 7,solmargin,satiryuksekligi,50,"Normal Çalýþma")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin,satiryuksekligi,50,"Hafta Tatili")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin,satiryuksekligi,50,"Resmi Tatil")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom,solmargin,satiryuksekligi,50,"Yýllýk Ýzin")

Function GetTPA(Tablo, PersonelKodu, TPAType)
	Dim TPAArray(1)
	TPAArray(0) = 0
	TPAArray(1) = 0
	Set TPA = Doc.Select2("WEQE", Tablo, "KOD='"+PersonelKodu+"'&ODEMETURU='"+TPAType+"'", "", -1)
	TPAArray(1) = TPA.GetRowCount()
	if TPA.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		TPA.GroupBy("KOD")
		TPAArray(0) = TPA.OR_BORCFIYAT(1)
	End if
	GetTPA = TPAArray
	xret= doc.DeleteTableObject("WEQE")
End Function

Function GetTPA(Tablo, PersonelKodu, TPAType)
	Dim TPAArray(1)
	TPAArray(0) = 0
	TPAArray(1) = 0
	Set TPA = Doc.Select2("WEQE", Tablo, "KOD='"+PersonelKodu+"'&ODEMETURU='"+TPAType+"'", "", -1)
	TPAArray(1) = TPA.GetRowCount()
	if TPA.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		TPA.GroupBy("KOD")
		TPAArray(0) = TPA.OR_BORCFIYAT(1)
	End if
	GetTPA = TPAArray
	xret= doc.DeleteTableObject("WEQE")
End Function

End Sub

	DevredenSigortali = SigortaliSayisi - 	IseGiren	
	AdayDevredenSigortali = AdaySigortali - 	AdayIseGiren	

	ToplamDevreden = DevredenSigortali + AdayDevredenSigortali
	ToplamGiren = 	IseGiren + AdayIseGiren
	ToplamSigortali = SigortaliSayisi + AdaySigortali

	ToplamSigorta = SigortaGun + AdaySigortaGun	
	ToplamBrut = BrutKazanc + AdayBrutKazanc

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*13+2,solmargin + 70,satiryuksekligi,10,AdayDevredenSigortali)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*15+2,solmargin + 87,satiryuksekligi,10,IseGiren)

Sub Makro1()
	OTOSP1L.Empty
	dosyaAdi = trim(OTOSP1E.FULLFILENAME1)
	if dosyaAdi = "" Then Exit Sub
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	Set TFile = fso.OpenTextFile(dosyaAdi, 1, True)
	While Not TFile.AtEndofStream
		satir = ltrim(TFile.ReadLine)
		if Left(satir, len("Malzeme No:")) = "Malzeme No:" Then
			stokKodu = Mid(satir, len("Malzeme No:")+1, 20)
		End if
		if Left(satir, 3) = "T  " Then
			Tarih = Mid(satir, 4, 10)
			Miktar = trim(Replace(Mid(satir, 20, 18), ".", ""))
			Attrib = Mid(satir, 39,1)
			AcikSipMik = trim(Replace(Mid(satir, 40, 18), ".", ""))
			satirNo = OTOSP1L.AddRow
			Doc.StatusBarMessage "Aktarýlýyor : " & satirNo
			OTOSP1L.SetCurrentRow(satirNo)
			OTOSP1L.D_ID = StokKodu
			OTOSP1L.RTESTARIH = Tarih
			OTOSP1L.SF_MIKTAR = Doc.CDbl(AcikSipMik)
			if Attrib = "D" Then
				OTOSP1L.ATTRIB = "G"
				OTOSP1L.PROGRAM_NO = "BAKIYE"
			Elseif Attrib = "F" Then
				OTOSP1L.ATTRIB = "G"
				OTOSP1L.PROGRAM_NO = "KESIN"
			Elseif Attrib = "P" Then
				OTOSP1L.ATTRIB = "G"
				OTOSP1L.PROGRAM_NO = "PLANLANAN"			
			End if
		End if
	Wend
	TFile.Close
End Sub

Sub IseGirisBilgileriDoldur(ByVal ExcelSheet,ByVal Satir,ByVal PersonelNo)
	Dim Tbl_PERSM0BT3
	Doc.RunCommand "CMD_CALISMA_UCRET_YENI_GIRIS_BASLA"
	Set Tbl_PERSM0BT3=Doc.GetTableObject("PERSM0BT3")

	Dim Alan10
	Dim AlanIsmi
	Dim AlanDegeri
	Dim Sutun
	For Sutun=2 To 100
		Alan10=Trim(ExcelSheet.Cells(1, Sutun))
		If Alan10="E" Then
			AlanIsmi=Trim(ExcelSheet.Cells(3, Sutun))
			AlanDegeri=ExcelSheet.Cells(Satir, Sutun)
			If AlanIsmi<>"" Then
				Tbl_PERSM0BT3.SetFieldValue AlanIsmi,0,AlanDegeri
			End If
		End If
	Next

	Doc.RunCommand "CMD_CALISMA_UCRET_YENI_GIRIS_OK"
End Sub

End Sub



Sub Makro1()
	Dim myExcel
	Dim mySheet
	Set myExcel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	myExcel.Workbooks.Open ("C:\CALISMA.XLS")
	Set mySheet = myExcel.Workbooks("CALISMA.XLS").Worksheets("CALISMA")

	Dim PersonelNo

	Dim Tbl_PERSM0BT3
	Set Tbl_PERSM0BT3=Doc.GetTableObject("PERSM0BT3")

	Dim YeniGiris
	Dim I		
	For I=6 To 1000
		PersonelNo=Trim(mySheet.Cells(I, 1))
		If PersonelNo<>"" Then
			PersonelNo=Doc.LeftJustify(PersonelNo,16)
			Doc.Load_Voucher PersonelNo
			If Trim(Doc.GetLoadedVoucher())=Trim(PersonelNo) Then
Msgbox(PersonelNo)
				YeniGiris=True
				Dim IT1
				IT1=Tbl_PERSM0BT3.GetRowCount()
				Do While IT1>=1
						'If Tbl_PERSM0BT3.AP10(IT1)="1" Then
						'	Tbl_PERSM0BT3.SetCurrentRow(IT1)
						'	YeniGiris=False
						'	Exit Do
						'End If
						IT1=IT1-1
				Loop
				If YeniGiris Then
Msgbox("Yeni")
					Call IseGirisBilgileriDoldur(mySheet,I,PersonelNo)
				Else
Msgbox("Eski")
					Call CalismaSartiDegisikligiDoldur(mySheet,I,PersonelNo)
				End If
				Doc.Save_Voucher
			Else
				MsgBox(Trim(PersonelNo) & " Nolu Personel Bulunamadý")
			End If
		End If
	Next

	myExcel.Quit

	Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub

Sub Makro1()
		Ay = Mid(BRDR1E.CTARIH1,6,2)
		Yil = Left(BRDR1E.CTARIH1,4)

		Tarih1 = Yil&"-"&Ay
		Tarih2 = BRDR1E.CTARIH1
		if BRDR1TP.getreccount()=0 Then 
			msgbox "Satýr bulunamadýðý için fiþ oluþturulamadý. Ýþlem Kesilmiþtir."		
			Exit Sub
		End if

		'Eksik Gün Bildirgesi yaratýlýyor.
		Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI2("PERSB08","","KRV09")
		nret = doc1.New_Voucher
		Set ST29E = Doc1.GetTableObject("PERSB08E")
		Set ST29T = Doc1.GetTableObject("PERSB08T")

		'Evrak Bilgii Kaydediliyor
		ST29E.TARIH = BRDR1E.CTARIH2
		ST29E.AY = Ay
		ST29E.YIL = Yil
		ST29E.IY_BILDIRGENO = BRDR1TP.ISYERIKODU(1)

		dim strEvrakno
		strEvrakno = ST29E.EVRAKNO
	for i = 1 to BRDR1TP.getreccount()
		SicilNo = BRDR1TP.KOD(i)
		NetOdenecek = BRDR1TP.NETODENECEK(i)
		Agi = BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_AGI(i)
		Donem = BRDR1TP.CTARIH1(i)
		KanunNo = BRDR1TP.KANUNNO(i)
		if trim(KanunNo) = "14857" or trim(KanunNo) = "54857" or trim(KanunNo) = "05510" then
			Indirim = BRDR1TP.MUA_SSK_OZR_KN(i)
		Elseif trim(KanunNo) = "14447" then
			Indirim = BRDR1TP.O4447_7_D21(i)
		End if
			
		IsciIsz = BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMII(i)	
		IsvIsz = BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMVI(i)
		IsciSGDP = BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMIS(i)
		IsvSGDP = BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMVS(i)
 		
		IsciPrimi = BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMIH(i)+BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMIM(i)	+BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMIS(i)
		IsvPrimi = BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMVH(i)+BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMVM(i)+BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMVK(i)+BRDR1TP.BUBRDR_SSKPRIMVS(i)-Indirim

		GV = BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_GV(i)
		GVMatrahi = BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_GVMATRAHI(i)
		DV = doc.div((BRDR1TP.BUBORDRO_BRUTKAZANC(i)*6),1000)

		ST29T.AddRow
		ST29T.SetCurrentRow(ST29T.Getreccount())
		satirNo = ST29T.GetRecCount()

		ST29T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirNo) = trim(SicilNo)
		ST29T.PEGK(satirNo) = doc.Numformat(Agi,14,2)
		ST29T.DEGERLENDIRMESONUCU(satirNo) = Donem
		ST29T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_1(satirNo) = doc.Numformat(DV,14,2)
		ST29T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_2(satirNo) = doc.Numformat(GV,14,2)
		ST29T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_3(satirNo) = doc.Numformat(IsciPrimi,14,2)
		ST29T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_4(satirNo) = doc.Numformat(IsciIsz,14,2)
		'ST29T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_5(satirNo) = doc.Numformat(IsciSGDP,14,2)
		ST29T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_6(satirNo) = doc.Numformat(IsvPrimi,14,2)
		ST29T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_7(satirNo) = doc.Numformat(IsvIsz,14,2)
		'ST29T.ARTIKEL_REF_NUM_8(satirNo) = doc.Numformat(Indirim,14,2)


	Next

	nret = Doc1.Save_Voucher()
	if nret <> 0 then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(ST29E.EVRAKNO & " No'lu evrak kaydedilemedi. Ýþlem kesilmiþtir","dinamo",MB_OK)
		Exit Sub
	Else
		msgbox strEvrakno & " nolu fiþ baþarýyla oluþturulmuþtur."
	end if
	nret = Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher()

End Sub

Dim DokumanAdi
Dim TabloAdi

Sub AlanlariDoldur(ByVal Doc1,ByVal ExcelSheet,ByVal Satir,ByVal KOD)
	Dim Tbl
	Set Tbl=Doc1.GetTableObject(TabloAdi)

	Dim AlanIsmi
	Dim AlanDegeri
	Dim Sutun
	For Sutun=2 To 100
		AlanIsmi=Trim(ExcelSheet.Cells(2, Sutun))
		AlanDegeri=ExcelSheet.Cells(Satir, Sutun)
		If AlanIsmi<>"" And AlanIsmi<>"KOD" Then
			Tbl.SetFieldValue AlanIsmi,0,AlanDegeri
		End If
	Next
End Sub


Sub Makro1()
	Dim myExcel
	Dim mySheet
	Set myExcel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	myExcel.Workbooks.Open ("C:\KARTLAR.XLS")
	Set mySheet = myExcel.Workbooks("KARTLAR.XLS").Worksheets("KARTLAR")

	DokumanAdi=Trim(mySheet.Cells(1, 1))
	TabloAdi=Trim(mySheet.Cells(1, 2))
	If DokumanAdi="" Then
		MsgBox("Döküman Türü Belirtilmemiþ")
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If TabloAdi="" Then
		MsgBox("Tablo Adý Belirtilmemiþ")
		Exit Sub
	End If

	Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI(DokumanAdi,"")
	Dim KOD
	Dim I		
	I=3
	Do While(I<50000)
		Doc.StatusBarMessage "Satýr :" & CStr(I) 
		KOD=Trim(mySheet.Cells(I, 1))
		If KOD<>"" Then
			KOD=Doc.LeftJustify(KOD,50)
			Doc1.Load_Voucher KOD
			If Trim(Doc1.GetLoadedVoucher())=Trim(KOD) Then
				Call AlanlariDoldur(Doc1,mySheet,I,KOD)
				Doc1.Save_Voucher
			Else
				MsgBox(Trim(KOD) & " Nolu Kart Yüklenemedi/Yaratýlamadý")
			End If
		Else
			Exit Do
		End If
		I=I+1
	Loop

	myExcel.Quit

	Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
End Sub
